findings: ScanLogger has one mutable active entry without operation ID. A second start overwrites the first; a subsequent finalize labels the new entry. Synthetic overlapping lifecycle confirmed, actual caller overlap not reproduced.
recoverStale computes wall-clock now minus original start, including downtime across reload/browser closure. This is not active scan CPU/GPU time or a completed-scan duration.

StabilityTracker initializes phase time at first positive progress event, excluding earlier phase work. Three zero-elapsed samples produce 0/0 in stability ratio; NaN comparison falls through and records stable estimatedMs=0. Confirmed with synthetic frozen clock, not a normal scan timing claim.

Logs contain total/candidates/cache hits and timings, but no failed-thumbnail/embedding count, input coverage proof, model digest or exact comparison evidence. Complete status is not exhaustive duplicate correctness proof.
ScanProgress does not reset cached ETA when changing between determinate phases and does not clear it on completion; previous ETA can remain until replaced. Percentage is not clamped.
formatEtr independently rounds seconds/minutes, permitting 60-second or 60-minute labels near boundaries. Message prop is accepted but not rendered by component.

executed_controls.method: Original logger/tracker transformed by Node TypeScript transform in VM, synthetic clocks and in-memory clone-on-write Chrome storage stub.

limits: No Chrome persistence, React component runtime, browser reload or actual scan performance measurement.
